## Overview

Captured [[adyen]] Management API `DELETE /merchants/{merchantId}/terminalThemes/{id}/assets` reference, with a v3 test server. It deletes one asset from a terminal theme owned by the merchant account in the path. The required `type` and `model` query parameters identify that asset; `merchantId` and theme `id` are required path identifiers. The API credential needs the **Management API - Terminal themes read and write** role.

## Key takeaways

- A logo uses `type=logo` and `model=All`. Deletion is blocked if the theme owner cannot edit logos. Other screen types require a single Android terminal model; `idleScreen` and `shopperEngagementScreen` support only SFO1 or M450.
- The documented 204 means the asset was deleted. The reference does not state when a terminal displays a changed theme or whether an applied theme is automatically updated on device.
- The reference lists 401, 403, 404, 422, and 500 failures. Its 403 example illustrates the logo edit prohibition; 404 illustrates a missing type/model asset. Example details are not guaranteed error text.

quotes.text: Deletes a single asset from a terminal theme owned by the merchant account specified in the path. To identify the asset you want to remove, you must use the query parameters `type` and `model`.
When the `type` is **logo**, deleting the asset is blocked if the theme owner is not allowed to edit logos.
- Management API - Terminal themes read and write

| model | string | Yes | The Android terminal model that the asset is for. Use **All** only if the `type` is **logo**. For every other screen type specify a single Android terminal model such as **AMS1**. |

| type | string | Yes | The screen type or screen element that the asset is for:  - **logo**: your logo. Only supported if `model` is **All**.  - **homeScreen**: the default background screen.  - **idleScreen**: a screensaver shown when the terminal is inactive. Only supported if `model` is **SFO1** or **M450**.  - **afterPaymentScreen**: a screen shown after the payment is completed.  - **shopperEngagementScreen**: a screen shown during [shopper engagement](https://docs.adyen.com/point-of-sale/shopper-engagement) requests. Only supported if `model` is **SFO1** or **M450**. |
